title: Full Constants Table
concepts: Comprehensive table of ~100+ physical constants with triad (a,b,c) assignments
Each constant assigned integer triple (a,b,c) generating T(a,b,c) = φ^a + π^b + φ^c
Error percentages ranging from 0.0015% (proton magnetic moment) to 2.7% (Planck temperature)
Constants span categories: nuclear, particle, atomic, cosmology, QCD, QED, EM, electroweak, thermo, astro, planck, mixing, neutrino, derived, mound
Discrete lattice of candidate values from integer triples, not continuous fitting
equations: T(a,b,c) = φ^a + π^b + φ^c for each constant
key_results: Best fit: Proton Magnetic Moment μ_p, error 0.00154%
Worst fits: Hartree Energy (2.21%), Schwarzschild Radius of Sun (2.27%), Proton Charge Radius (2.35%), Curvature Density (2.58%), Planck Temperature (2.71%)
